courses.summary: 以磷礦、礦漿輸送及下游處理整合為案例，分開固體、水與能量邊界。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A phosphate mine, slurry transport and downstream-treatment case separates solids, water and energy boundaries. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
